description: The bar chart illustrates the effect of different multilingual BERT models (mBERT-L2, XLM-L2, mBERT-R2, XLM-R2, mBERT-B2, XLM-B2) on various linguistic features such as case, gender, tag, number, and tense. The x-axis represents the linguistic features, while the y-axis measures the effect, which is a numerical value indicating the performance or impact of the models on these features. Each bar represents a model's effect on a specific feature, with the height of the bar indicating the magnitude of the effect. The bars are color-coded to distinguish between the different models. The chart includes error bars, which represent the variability or confidence interval of the effect measurements. The chart does not provide any information on the sorting or emphasis of the bars.
